test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **'frequently'**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The passage discusses how social media companies claim to promote democracy and empower individuals.
 
• The word to fill in blank number 1 should indicate how often these claims are made by social media companies.
 
• "**Frequently**" fits best as it means that these companies often make such claims, aligning with the context of the passage.
 
• Other options like "**seldom**", "**never**", and "**don't**" do not fit the logical context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'frequently'**.

 

Complete Passage: *Social media companies (1)* **frequently**__ *claim that they promote democracy and are dedicated to the empowerment of ordinary individuals. The assertion (2)* ______ *entirely unfounded. Recent history shows how (3)* ______ *citizens have been mobilised against totalitarian regimes on social networking sites. Starting from MeToo to Black Lives Matter, digital networks (4)* ______ *indispensable in bringing together critical voices against social and political (5)* ______. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Seldom**: Means rarely, which does not align with the idea that social media companies often make these claims.
 
• **Never**: Means not at all, which contradicts the passage's context of these claims being made.
 
• **Don't**: Grammatically incorrect in this context.
